features.name: Procedure State and Step Lifecycle Tracking
features.description: Tracks procedure lifecycle progression through run-level status, current step pointer, completed steps list, remaining steps list, and per-step execution records.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Maintains current_state with status set to 'completed', procedure.current_step set to null, procedure.completed_steps set to [0,1,2,3,4], and procedure.remaining_steps set to [].

features.name: Granular Key-for-Key Evaluative Mirroring
features.description: Recursively mirrors every returned execution key and array element at the exact schema path, replacing raw values with an evaluative object containing an evaluation verdict (e.g., PASS/FAIL) and supervisor comment.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Specifies instruction to create an exact key-for-key, entry-by-entry evaluative mirror replacing terminal returned values with evaluation and supervisor comment across start_of_turn fields.
Mirrors array entries under stated_requirements, evaluating each individual extracted requirement separately with PASS/comment.

features.name: Holistic Step-Level Supervisory Evaluation
features.description: Performs holistic step evaluation over returned entries, governing instructions, user requests, authorization context, and failure modes following granular mirroring.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Evaluates the complete step as a unit after granular evaluation, producing an overall evaluation rating of PASS and explanatory comment.

features.name: Supervisory Gate Result Transition Gating
features.description: Blocks advancement to the subsequent step unless the supervisory gate explicitly concludes with gate_result of PASS, recording transition metadata in transition_key and transition_value.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Records transition_key as 'supervisory_gate.gate_result' and transition_value as 'PASS' with instruction mandating next execution step is permitted only when gate_result is PASS.

features.name: Granular and Step-Level Failure Recording
features.description: Maintains an explicit failures list capturing independent entries for each FAIL encountered during granular or step-level evaluation without combining independent failures.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines instruction requiring one list entry for every FAIL in granular_evaluation or step_level_evaluation with empty array value when no failures occur.

features.name: Per-Step Attempt Counting
features.description: Tracks execution attempt counts for individual procedure steps within step records.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Records attempt counter set to 1 for step 0 execution and verification.

features.name: Isolated Persisted Run Container Architecture
features.description: Encapsulates each execution run inside an isolated directory containing exactly three tracked artifacts: messages.json, state.json, and store/store.json.

evidence.mechanic_summary: States that each run directory is an isolated persisted execution container containing exactly three tracked files: messages.json, state.json, and store/store.json.

features.name: Shared Supervisor Path Configuration
features.description: Centralizes external path settings, trigger file locations, runs directory path, and canonical evaluation artifacts across specification and runtime.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Documents config.json as shared configuration declaring the Agents file, trigger file, runs directory, and canonical Step 3 evaluation artifact.

features.name: Primary Gemini Supervisor Node.js Runtime Engine
features.description: Executes state machine logic, loads shared configuration and Agents contracts, validates returns, executes live-ground-truth checks, calls Gemini supervisory gates, and persists records.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Identifies send-to-gemini.js as active Node runtime that validates step returns, performs live-ground-truth checks, invokes Gemini supervisory gates, persists run records, and advances/retries state.

features.name: Google Apps Script Function Evaluation Endpoint Bridge
features.description: Accepts JavaScript source code and arguments via a doPost HTTP endpoint, compiles/evaluates the function, and returns JSON-serialized output.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Describes Code.gs as standalone Google Apps Script doPost endpoint accepting sourcecode and arguments, evaluating the function, and returning JSON-serialized results.

features.name: Live Ground Truth Verification Skill
features.description: Requires agent execution, completion, and status claims to be validated strictly against authoritative live sources rather than model memory or self-reported status.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Specifies skill requiring execution/completion/status claims to be verified against exact live authoritative sources rather than memory or agent self-report.

features.name: Workflow Trigger Payload Ingestion
features.description: Ingests next-message workflow triggers supplying run_nonce, execution role/step indicators, and the ChatGPT-owned return schema consumed by the Node runtime.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines nextmessage.json carrying run_nonce, execution role/step, and the ChatGPT-owned return schema consumed by the Node runtime.

features.name: Work Action Approval and Safe-Word Classification
features.description: Enforces safe-word authorization requirements, action classifications, and governance rules for work action approvals via a dedicated rulebook.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines work-action-approval-rulebook.json as standalone JSON rulebook defining safe-word authorization, action classification, and related work-action approval semantics.

features.name: Step 3 Heuristic and TSR Question Corpus Evaluation
features.description: Combines Step 3 TSR (Test Return Schema) evaluation heuristics with a complete question corpus into a single machine-readable evaluation artifact.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Documents step-3-evaluation.json as active combined JSON artifact containing the Step 3 evaluation heuristic plus the complete step3_tsr question corpus.
